description: Download one message's document (a signed PDF, as SPV serves it) into the downloads outbox, named <posted date>_<type>_<SPV's file name>. Answers the path, size and SHA-256. Saving the same bytes again finds them there (already_there) instead of writing a copy. A file SPV names for another message (another request's id) is refused as wrong_document and not saved.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the downloads outbox (e.g. "2026-10"); empty means the outbox itself. A path outside it is refused.

name: download_message
title: Download a message
